jobs.description:
Overview
 Collaborate with brilliant minds who challenge, inspire, and elevate each other to new heights. As a Solution Engineer for Data in the Technology Sales team, you help enterprise customers reimagine what is possible with their data. You partner closely with technical and business leaders to translate complex challenges into clear solution paths, ensuring that every engagement moves customers closer to their strategic goals.

In this role, you are at the forefront of data transformation, guiding customers as they unlock value from their data estate with Microsoft Fabric, Azure databases, analytics, and artificial intelligence solutions. You lead hands-on customer engagements such as proof of concept projects, hackathons, and architecture workshops that influence technology strategy and measurable business outcomes. You build deep expertise across cloud platforms, analytics, governance, and artificial intelligence while continuously learning and shaping how organizations modernize, migrate, and innovate with their data. Join this team to accelerate customer success, expand your technical breadth, and influence how organizations build their next generation of data and artificial intelligence solutions.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.

Responsibilities

• Engage proactively with customers to build credibility as a trusted advisor by combining customer context, solution expertise, and technical and industry knowledge.

• Lead technical discussions, demonstrations, and proof of concept activities to ensure technical wins for core and adjacent Microsoft technologies, establishing clear rules of engagement and handoffs across virtual teams.

• Design and present solution architectures that span data, analytics, and artificial intelligence scenarios, driving cross-workload support for Microsoft solutions that address customer modernization and migration needs.

• Act as a liaison in partner sell-with scenarios, coordinating partner and internal resources throughout engagements and identifying partner skill or resource gaps that can inform internal readiness plans.

• Capture market insights from customer engagements and feed them back to product, engineering, and account teams to refine strategies, strengthen Microsoft’s value proposition, and shape customer success and consumption plans.

Qualifications
 Required/Minimum Qualifications

• Master's / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
• AND several years of technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience, including several years of experience with cloud databases, analytics solutions and or databases on premises, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.

• OR equivalent experience.

• This roles involves collaboration with local customers, therefore fluency in German and/or French is required.
 Preferred Qualifications

• Desired technical depth (L400) and Certifications:
•
• Database: DP-800 SQL AI Developer Associate

• Database: DP-420 Azure Cosmos DB Developer

• DP-700 Fabric Data Engineer Associate

jobs.description:
Overview
 We are seeking a Data Research Engineer to join our AI team , where we are building the next generation of foundation models across different modalities: text, image, video, audio. If you are passionate about exploring, designing, and building high-quality datasets to drive frontier AI models, this role is for you.

At Microsoft AI, data is at the heart of innovation—and in this role, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues to curate, analyse, and evaluate diverse data sources critical to model development. You’ll lead efforts in developing novel data collection strategies, improving dataset quality, understanding data-driven model behaviours, and aligning datasets with ethical and societal values.

This is a cross-disciplinary, high-impact role ideal for engineers who want to push the boundaries of what AI can learn from data.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Create high-quality datasets for training and evaluation; run experiments on new datasets (data ablations) to assess their impact and determine the most effective data

• Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, pre-processing, filtering, and annotation

• Analyse real-world multimodal datasets to assess quality, diversity, relevance, and identify areas for improvement

• Build tools and workflows for dataset auditing, visualization, and versioning

• Collaborate with Safety, Ethics, and Governance teams to ensure datasets meet standards for quality, privacy, and responsible AI practices

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree in AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Proficiency in Python.

• Experience with distributed data-processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray and workflow-orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience with processing datasets at many petabyte scale and with trillion rows.

• Experience building datasets for training foundation models, including language or multimodal models.

• Strong experience in data analysis, data engineering, or both.

• Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and effectively to research, engineering, and product teams.

• Experience evaluating dataset quality and measuring the impact of data through controlled model-training experiments.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

• Experience working with large-scale, real-world datasets that are unstructured or semi-structured

• Experience with multimodal data, such as image, video, or audio data.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Panoramica

Stiamo cercando Data Research Engineers di unirsi al nostro team Multimodal, dove stiamo costruendo la prossima generazione di modelli di fondazione attraverso la visione, la lingua, l'audio e oltre. Se siete appassionati di esplorare, progettare e costruire set di dati di alta qualità per guidare i modelli AI di frontiera, questo ruolo è per voi.

In Microsoft AI, i dati sono al centro dell'innovazione, e in questo ruolo, collaborerai a stretto contatto con scienziati, ingegneri e annotatori per curare, analizzare e valutare diverse fonti di dati multimodali critiche allo sviluppo del modello. Condurrai gli sforzi nello sviluppo di nuove strategie di raccolta dei dati, nel miglioramento della qualità dei dataset, nella comprensione dei comportamenti dei modelli basati sui dati e nell'allineamento dei dataset con valori etici e sociali.

Questo è un ruolo interdisciplinare, ad alto impatto ideale per gli ingegneri che vogliono spingere i confini di ciò che l'IA può imparare dai dati, soprattutto in contesti multimodali.

La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti ci uniamo a una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

responsabilità

Creare set di dati di alta qualità per la formazione e la valutazione; eseguire esperimenti su nuovi set di dati (ablazioni di dati) per valutare il loro impatto e determinare i dati più efficaci

Sviluppare e mantenere le pipeline di dati scalabili per ingestione multimodale, pre-elaborazione, filtraggio e annotazione

Analizzare i dataset multimodali del mondo reale per valutare la qualità, la diversità, la rilevanza e identificare le aree per il miglioramento

Costruisci strumenti e flussi di lavoro leggeri per l'auditing dataset, la visualizzazione e la versione

Collabora con i team di Sicurezza, Etica e Governance per garantire che i set di dati soddisfino gli standard di qualità, privacy e pratiche AI responsabili

Qualifiche
Obbligo
• Qualifiche:

Corso di laurea in AI, Informatica, Scienza dei dati, Statistica, Fisica, Ingegneria, o un campo tecnico correlato E esperienza di ingegneria tecnica con codifica in lingue tra cui, ma non solo, Python e biblioteche di dati comuni (Panda, NumPy, ecc.)

O esperienza equivalente

Esperienza nell'analisi dei dati o nell'ingegneria dei dati

Proficienza delle statistiche e dei metodi di analisi dei dati esplorativi

Capacità di comunicare efficacemente i risultati tecnici ai team di ricerca e di prodotto

Preferito
• Qualifiche:

Laurea Magistrale in Informatica o relativo campo tecnico E esperienza di ingegneria tecnica con codifica in lingue tra cui, ma non solo, Python e biblioteche di dati comuni (Panda, NumPy, ecc.)

Familiarità con i framework di elaborazione dati come Spark, Ray, Apache Beam

Esperienza di lavoro con dataset su larga scala, reali che sono strutturati o semi-strutturati

Overview
 Process and Tooling Team Introduction
 Cloud Interconnection & Acquisition | Network Fiber
 Who We Are
 We are the Process and Tooling team supporting CIA Network Fiber, focused on simplifying how teams plan, source, deliver, and manage fiber work across regions. Our team partners closely with sourcing, delivery, engineering, operations, GIS, and regional stakeholders to turn complex workflows into clear, scalable processes and practical tooling solutions.
 Our Mission
 Our mission is to create consistent, efficient, and repeatable ways of working that reduce manual effort, improve visibility, and help teams move fiber programs forward with greater speed and confidence. We focus on standardizing processes, improving tool adoption, clarifying ownership, and enabling better decision-making through reliable data and well-defined workflows.

Responsibilities
 Responsibilities:
 We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive process & tooling optimization and automation, primarily focused on AI driven improvements to accelerate transformation across global cloud and network operations.
 This role sits at the intersection of business process optimization, AI adoption, tooling, and intelligent automation engineering. You will lead the identification, development, and scaling of AI powered capabilities, process improvement and tooling requirements —embedding Copilot, automation, and predictive analytics into operational workflows to improve speed to market, data quality, cost efficiency, and decision making.
 The ideal candidate thrives in complex, matrixed environments, can move seamlessly between strategy and execution, and delivers measurable impact through responsible, scalable AI solutions.

• Map, analyze, and optimize end-to-end operational processes across network sourcing, inventory, planning, fiber lifecycle, and engineering workflows.

• Eliminate friction, standardize practices, and reduce cycle times using AI enabled automation.

• Partner with CIA and our partner teams to ensure integrated, scalable tooling solutions aligned to business priorities.
 AI, Data & System Integration

• Strengthen data quality, interoperability, and automation across network and operational tools.

• Enable AI powered data cleansing, reconciliation, forecasting, and predictive modeling.

• Support system modernization initiatives to ensure platforms are AI‑ready and interoperable.

• Act as a connector between business owners, engineering teams, and AI/data science resources.

• Design, develop, and deploy agents and agent flows that support operational workflows.

• Translate repeatable patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

• Ensure AI solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with engineering best practices.

• Integrate automation solutions with existing systems and Microsoft platforms.

• Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI and automation solutions in production environments.

• Contribute to technical documentation, operational readiness, and knowledge sharing.

• Lead AI change management efforts to drive AI literacy and adoption across teams.

• Develop training, documentation, and communications that accelerate responsible AI usage.

• Foster an AI first, growth mindset culture grounded in Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, security, and governance standards.

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, Telecommunications, Finance, or related field AND some experience in these fields OR equivalent experience

• Some experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects
 Preferred Qualifications:

• Some experience in cloud, data center, or large‑scale network environments.

• Solid experience in program management, process improvement, automation, or operations.

• Hands‑on experience with AI tools, including Copilot and/or Copilot Studio.

• Experience developing automation or analytics solutions using Python or similar languages.

• Strong understanding of network or infrastructure lifecycles.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel with financial or operational data.

• Proven ability to influence across highly matrixed organizations.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience designing and implementing Copilot agents and agent flows, including prompt design.

• Familiarity with Azure services, Kusto queries, APIs, or enterprise data platforms.

• Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or value‑stream mapping.

• Understanding of carrier networks, fiber delivery, or outside plant engineering.

• PMP or equivalent certification.

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics or similar enterprise systems.

• Familiarity with AI readiness assessments or enterprise AI frameworks.

As a Partner Development Manager, you'll be at the center of the AI era — partnering with the most disruptive Software Development Companies to accelerate their go-to-market strategies and co-shape the next generation of cloud solutions. Enterprise Partner Solutions, part of Microsoft’s Industry & Partner Sales (IPS) organization, is accountable for building and co-selling innovative Microsoft Cloud & AI solutions and services, with our global Enterprise partners. Our Enterprise partner portfolio includes global systems integrators, advisories, high-value management consultancies (SI), software development companies (SDC) - working together to empower people and organizations to achieve more. The SDC team at Microsoft operates at the frontier of what's possible — partnering with organizations across the full innovation spectrum, from early stage startups to established market leaders, to help them build, launch, and scale transformative solutions powered by the Microsoft platform.

As a Partner Development Manager, you'll be at the center of the AI era — partnering with the most disruptive Software Development Companies to accelerate their go-to-market strategies and co-shape the next generation of cloud solutions. This is your opportunity to sharpen your business acumen at the intersection of AI and industry transformation, elevate your commercial craft, and architect bold market strategies that move at the speed of innovation.

You are required to bring your work ethic, enthusiasm, optimism, and customer-centric passion to stimulate growth and transformation within our partner ecosystem. Your challenger mindset, sales management skills, technological and industry knowledge, and superior interpersonal abilities will be leveraged to empower our partners in delivering market-defining solutions to our customers. This role offers you the chance to fast-track your career growth as you engage with intricate partner organizations, establish robust relationships in the C-Suite, and collaborate with multiple stakeholders to boost performance and tackle complex issues.
What We Value in This Role

• Growth mindset — You approach every partner conversation as a learning opportunity, staying curious about technology trends and constantly evolving your strategies alongside the market

• Accountability with integrity — You own your partners' outcomes — the wins and the misses — and you show up with transparency and honesty in every relationship

• Challenger spirit — You bring bold ideas to the table, push partners to think bigger, and aren't afraid to reframe the conversation when it unlocks greater opportunity

• Inclusion and empathy — You build trust across diverse partner organizations, cultures, and leadership styles, creating environments where every partner feels genuinely invested in

• Collaborative by nature — You thrive in a One Microsoft model, rallying internal stakeholders and breaking down silos to deliver for your partners and customers

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• You will champion a dynamic portfolio of Software Development Companies (SDCs) — spanning cloud solutions and industry verticals — accelerating their journey into the Microsoft ecosystem to help them innovate faster, launch breakthrough products, unlock new markets, and scale their customer base. You will also spearhead the strategic recruitment of next-generation partners, targeting organizations aligned with Microsoft's AI priorities, Solution Area Plays, and market imperatives.

• You will architect and execute bold partner business plans — anchored in Microsoft's strategic objectives — that fuel cloud consumption, accelerate digital transformation, and unlock both near-term wins and long-term growth for your managed partners. Plans will be precision-engineered to each partner's unique capabilities and ambitions.

• You will design high-impact go-to-market strategies and co-sell execution plays, leading partner pipeline reviews and coaching partners to sharpen their sales and consumption approach. You will bridge Microsoft and partner sales teams to break down barriers, outcompete, and build winning proposals — driving toward revenue and consumption targets, closing top opportunities through the Microsoft sales methodology, and accelerating transactions through the marketplace.

• You will own your partners' performance end-to-end, maintaining a consistent cadence of engagement with executive, sales, and delivery teams to surface and eliminate execution blockers, drive program adoption, and accelerate results. You will lead with accountability — designing and driving correction plans that put partners back on a trajectory for growth.

• You will earn a seat at the table as a trusted advisor to C-suite leaders of complex partner organizations — aligning their vision, strategies, and growth ambitions with Microsoft's to forge mutually powerful account plans that deliver strategic and commercial impact.

• You will drive the development of capability and capacity plans that equip your partners with the right blend of sales acumen and technical depth — empowering them to build high-impact Microsoft offerings, grow thriving practices, and accelerate cloud consumption and digital transformation.

• You will be the voice of the partner internally — leading resolution of complex, high-stakes escalations with urgency and precision. You will rally the right stakeholders to prioritize partner needs, breaking down silos across Microsoft and within the partner organization to accelerate performance and unlock execution at scale.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, or related field/related experience AND several years of experience in partner management, business development, channel sales, or ISV/SDC ecosystem management within the technology industry

• Proven track record of building and scaling partner relationships that deliver measurable revenue and cloud consumption growth

• Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in a cloud or SaaS environment AND experience in engaging and influencing C-suite stakeholders

jobs.description:
Overview
 Microsoft Customer & Partner Solutions accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable added value, driving growth that outpaces the market.
 As a Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM), you serve as the primary customer success leader responsible for orchestrating customer outcomes across Microsoft and partner teams. You engage stakeholders, align on strategic priorities, and lead Customer Success Planning to help customers strengthen operational health, accelerate cloud adoption, and advance AI transformation initiatives. By connecting customer goals to Microsoft capabilities, Success Programs, and Success Management Services, you drive coordinated execution and measurable value realization. You proactively manage customer risks, guide governance and delivery rhythms, and help ensure customers achieve durable outcomes that strengthen trust and expand the value of their Microsoft investments.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Build trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders and Microsoft teams, helping align technology investments to strategic business priorities and outcomes.

• Lead stakeholder and priority alignment efforts across customer organizations, establishing shared objectives, success measures, and governance approaches.

• Own Customer Success Planning and execution, translating business priorities into coordinated success motions that drive measurable customer value.

• Orchestrate cross-functional execution that strengthens customer health, accelerates cloud adoption, and advances AI transformation across customer environments.

• Leverage Success Management Services, Success Programs, and broader Microsoft resources to drive scaled execution, value realization, and customer success outcomes.

• Proactively manage customer risks, adoption challenges, and delivery dependencies, guiding stakeholders toward resolution and long-term success.

• Serve as a customer advocate and customer success leader, continuously improving execution effectiveness and helping customers realize durable business value from Microsoft investments.

Qualifications
 Required Qualificatons:

• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sociology, Psychology, Computer Science or related field AND solid customer success, solution delivery, practice management, customer-facing consulting, or portfolio management experience

• OR equivalent experience.

• This role requires collaboration with local customers; therefore, fluency in German is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Microsoft certification in relevant technologies (e.g., Azure, M365, Copilot)

• Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation certification or equivalent service management certification

• Project Management Institute (PMI) or equivalent Project Management certification

• Prosci or equivalent certification

Overview
 This is an early-in-career opportunity intended for candidates with limited professional experience.

The CSAM is an early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
 Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation – reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
 This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

Responsibilities
 Executive partnership and execution

• Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.

• Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.

• Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.
 Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation

• Maintain deep, current account context across the pod’s defined portfolio.

• Synthesize account signals into “what’s changed / what matters now”

• Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.

• Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.
 Execution orchestration (not delivery)

• Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.

• Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.

• Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.

• Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.
 Reactive signal aggregation

• Monitor reactive support signals – case volume, aging, repeat drivers – across the pod portfolio.

• Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.

• Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.

• Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.
 Operating model

• Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.

• Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.

• Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

Qualifications
 Required

• Bachelor’s degree (any discipline) or equivalent early-career experience.

• 0–2 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics.

• Demonstrated comfort with AI tools and AI-first ways of working.

• Strong written and verbal communication in English plus the language(s) required for the assigned hub.

• Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Zurich, Switzerland (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.) Relocation expenses are not provided as part of this role.

• Fluency in English must be mandatory

Overview
 Join Microsoft’s Manufacturing Industry ATU to help some of the world’s leading manufacturers accelerate their AI and digital transformation journeys. As an Account Technology Strategist (ATS), you will serve as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business leaders, aligning technology investments with strategic business outcomes. You will bring deep manufacturing industry expertise and a understanding of challenges and opportunities across engineering, operations, supply chain, smart factories, and workforce transformation. Leveraging end-to-end knowledge across AI, Data & Analytics, Security, Business Applications, Modern Work, and Azure Infrastructure, you will shape and execute transformative technology strategies. Working closely with Account Executives, solution specialists, partners, and engineering teams, you will lead executive engagements and create industry-specific innovation roadmaps. This role offers the opportunity to influence the future of manufacturing while driving business growth and delivering measurable customer impact.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.
